name: webdriverio-mcp-server
description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server for Web Automation with WebDriverIO and TypeScript

scripts.test: npm run test:api && BROWSERS=chrome,firefox,safari npx wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts && npm run allure:regen-open
scripts.test:smoke: npx wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --spec ./tests/smoke/home.smoke.spec.ts && npm run allure:regen-open
scripts.test:a11y: npx wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --spec ./tests/accessibility/a11y.spec.ts && npm run allure:regen-open
scripts.test:links: npx wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --spec ./tests/links/link-health.spec.ts && npm run allure:regen-open
scripts.test:forms: npx wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --spec ./tests/forms/contact-form.spec.ts && npm run allure:regen-open
scripts.test:video: BROWSERS=chrome,firefox,safari npx wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --spec ./tests/functional/video-products.spec.ts && npm run allure:regen-open
scripts.test:chrome: npm run test:api && BROWSERS=chrome npx wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts && npm run allure:regen-open
scripts.test:firefox: npm run test:api && BROWSERS=firefox npx wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts && npm run allure:regen-open
scripts.test:safari: npm run test:api && BROWSERS=safari npx wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts && npm run allure:regen-open
scripts.test:api: mkdir -p reports/api && newman run postman/collections/newsela-public-smoke.postman_collection.json -e postman/environments/newsela-environment.json --reporters=cli,json --reporter-json-export=reports/api/newman-results.json && tsx scripts/newman-to-allure.ts
scripts.allure:regen-open: npm run allure:generate && if [ -z "$SKIP_ALLURE_OPEN" ]; then tsx scripts/open-allure.ts; else echo 'Allure report generated at reports/allure-report/index.html'; fi

author: Development Team
